test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 28 June, 2023 Shift 4)

question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Those were only __crocodile tears.__
solution:
The correct answer is “**Pretended sadness”**.
